findings.message: IX001: memo text is not UTF-8 validated by stellar-core; check utf8.ValidString or store the raw bytes
findings.note: utils.Memo returns MEMO_TEXT as a Go string without UTF-8 validation. Nothing outside tests calls it at this ref and no migration has a memo column, so it is not reachable today. Worth a guard before memos are stored. No upstream issue filed.
